title: Instrument register
description: Component-aware instrument definitions (directive §40, §4.5). A definition describes a SYSTEM; the system is made of one or more separately controlled COMPONENTS. Ratemeter/probe and base-unit/probe combinations are modelled as two components of one system, never as an ad-hoc paired exception on a single record.

capabilities.description: The closed set of survey capabilities an instrument system can satisfy.

unit.description: Display unit, e.g. 'uSv/h', 'cps'. Shown next to every numeric input for this capability (§29).

backgroundRequired.description: Whether an at-issue background reading is required for this capability (§19). Background is recorded per instrument+component+capability and NEVER collapsed across capabilities (§4.8).

systemType.description: Drives how many components the capability card renders (§15).

components.description: Each component is independently identified, calibrated and checked. Primary and paired components carry SEPARATE serial, calibration, pre-use, post-use and background state (§4.3, §15).

capabilities.description: Capabilities this specific component contributes. The system satisfies a capability only when the contributing component is itself valid.
